review.why: Review a branch, pull request or uncommitted change for the interface problems it introduced or regressed, with a status on every finding.
review.summary: Reviews a change instead of a screen: resolves the diff scope (branch range plus uncommitted work, a PR, a range), expands to the surfaces and consumers affected, reads removed lines for lost accessibility or motion safeguards, and marks each finding Introduced, Regression or Pre-existing. Hands the report format to better-interface.
strengths: Never guesses a scope: with a clean tree it states the facts and offers routes.
Reads the minus side of the diff and checks whether the change replaces what it removed.
Read-only: fetches refs, never checks out or stashes the author's working tree.
cautions: Marked user-invoked only (disable-model-invocation), so it runs when you call it, not automatically.
Needs git, and better-interface plus the domain skills; otherwise it reports the scope and stops.
